title: Anthropic联合创始人：安全理念融入公司基因
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: My co-founders and I started in THROPIC because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the benefit of humankind.
segments.zh: 我和联合创始人创立Anthropic，是因为我们相信这个时代最强大的技术应当造福人类。

segments.en: Danielle and I lost our father to a disease that just a few years later became curable.
segments.zh: Danielle和我因一种疾病失去了父亲，而短短几年后这种病已可治愈。

segments.en: I started my career in biology hoping to help future cures come sooner.
segments.zh: 我以生物学开启职业生涯，希望帮助未来的疗法更早到来。

segments.en: In the lab, I saw the vast thicket of complexity that scientists face when they're trying to understand disease and develop new treatments.
segments.zh: 在实验室里，我看到了科学家在理解疾病和开发新疗法时面临的巨大复杂性。

segments.en: So many of the scientific tools that can cut through that thicket, tools for gene editing, tools for gene synthesis, tools for controlling brain cells with light, started as pure ideas.
segments.zh: 许多能穿透这种复杂性的科学工具，如基因编辑、基因合成、光控脑细胞工具，都始于纯粹的想法。

segments.en: In other words, they came from thinking, from intelligence. Human intelligence has already made diseases like plague, smallpox, and polio history for most of the world.
segments.zh: 换句话说，它们源于思考，源于智能。人类智能已让鼠疫、天花和小儿麻痹症在世界上大部分地区成为历史。

segments.en: But progress on other diseases has been too slow for so many patients and their families.
segments.zh: 但对其他疾病的进展对许多患者和家庭来说太慢了。

segments.en: Going from a great idea to a treatment can take decades. It took many years from the first discovery of a strange repeating pattern in DNA to the approval of the first treatment for disease using CRISPR.
segments.zh: 从伟大想法到疗法可能需要数十年。从首次发现DNA中奇怪的重复模式到首批CRISPR疗法获批，用了很多年。

segments.en: Nature is full of these patterns, but we've had too little intelligence to decipher most of them, too few scientists with too few time.
segments.zh: 自然界充满这些模式，但我们智能太少，无法破译大部分，科学家太少、时间太少。

segments.en: Now we can build that intelligence. Whether it's protein folding, drug design, cancer genetics, or clinical trial administration, scientists across many areas of biology and medicine are finding cloth can help them do their research in a fraction of the time it would have taken just a couple of years ago.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以构建这种智能。无论是蛋白质折叠、药物设计、癌症遗传学还是临床试验管理，许多生物学和医学领域的科学家发现Cloth能帮助他们以几年前几分之一的时间完成研究。
